observations: Photo 0 shows four black rectangular devices with the PlayStation logo on top, arranged in a 2x2 grid. They appear to be PlayStation 4 Slim consoles based on shape and logo.
Photo 1 shows one of the consoles wrapped in plastic, with two controllers (one black, one red) and cables on top, placed on a patterned surface.
The consoles in photo 0 show minor surface scratches and dust, especially on the top right unit.
The red controller in photo 1 appears to be a third-party or non-standard controller, not an official Sony DualShock 4.
No power cord, HDMI cable, or games are visible in the photos.
The seller claims 'UK used clean with games and 2 pad' — 'pad' likely means controllers.
The watermark 'MX GAMES & GADGET' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on both photos.
